build_index_atlas: build a FAISS index by encoding passages into embeddings using the Atlas retriever in fp16
retrieve_passages_atlas: retrieve top-k relevant passages for a query using the Atlas retriever with optional reranking
generate_answers_atlas: generate answer text from tokenized passages using the Atlas reader model with beam search
tokenize_passages_atlas: tokenize query and passage pairs for both the reader and retriever models using encode_passages
compute_reader_loss_atlas: compute the reader loss and logits for tokenized input using the Atlas reader model
